# Private static field source names

These independently authored Java programs exercise mutable generic callback
storage and a volatile long field. A disclosed constant-pool name-only encoding
gives both private fields names that Java source cannot spell. Code attributes,
descriptors, flags and all other class bytes remain unchanged.

Frozen callers observe exact static initialization order, sticky initialization
failure, callbacks and null, wide extrema, partial writes and returned identity.
Owned and imported observer variants reconcile every original entry and metadata
field, permitting only the two reported field names. Five wrong programs must
fail the same observers. No application data is used.
